title: Profile
description: A named composition: which deployables a build carries, and where they are going. A profile groups what is deployed together — by one operation, to one place (D-23) — and the verb chooses the posture, so a development run and a release run of the same product are the same profile rather than two documents that must agree (D-16).

profile.description: The profile's name; also its file name under Profiles/.

topology.description: How emulate runs a selected deployable. Keys are Integration.Deployable and must name a deployable this profile selects — the binding enforces the subset. host is the only run mode today; vm arrives with the promoted uroborOS validation surface.

destination.description: Where this profile's deployables are going. A selection whose own destination does not resolve here is refused by the binding.

deployables.description: The chosen deployables, each named by its integration and its own name. A profile is a choice: it may deliberately carry less than everything that could reach its destination.
